hero_title: A new kind of finance partner for South African businesses
hero_lead: Founder-led, qualified and committed to making your numbers make sense.
story:
Too many business owners make important decisions without a clear view of their finances. Records fall behind, SARS deadlines creep up, and reports, when they arrive, are hard to understand.

Finlume was founded to change that. We act as your external finance department: we keep your books up to date, manage payroll and tax compliance, and turn your numbers into clear, practical insight.

As a newly launched firm, we are building every client relationship on the same foundation: accuracy, honesty and service that feels personal.
founder_bio:
Rochelle is a qualified accountant and the founder of Finlume. She started the firm to give growing businesses the kind of finance support usually only available to large companies: accurate, reliable and explained in plain language.

When you work with Finlume, you work directly with Rochelle. She oversees every client file personally and is committed to giving each business the clarity it needs to grow with confidence.
founder_quote: My goal is simple: that every client finishes each month knowing exactly where their business stands, and what to do next.
vision: To be the trusted finance partner that gives every growing South African business complete clarity over its numbers.
mission: To deliver accurate, timely and compliant accounting, tax and advisory services, explained in plain language, so owners can make confident decisions and focus on running their business.
